name: d3-scale · Band scales

title.zh: d3-scale · 查数据到坐标、颜色与类别位置

description.zh: 原生改Domain为a,b,c，核原SVG由六段变三段。 d3-scale 是 D3 中负责数据到视觉映射的比例尺模块，文档覆盖线性、时间、幂、对数、序数、色带等类型及 ticks、tickFormat、nice 等方法，源码以 ISC 许可在 GitHub 开源。
description.en: d3-scale is D3's scale module mapping data to visual representation, covering linear, time, pow, log, ordinal, band and other scales with ticks, tickFormat and nice methods; its source is open-source on GitHub under ISC.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by d3-scale (https://d3js.org/d3-scale).
Technology stack: javascript.
Component specification: 原生改Domain为a,b,c，核原SVG由六段变三段。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看模块首页的多类比例尺入口，再到Linear页核域、范围和逆映射API；Band页有分类域与比例尺图示。实际把Domain从六项改为三项后，原SVG重排成a、b、c三段。适合前端查坐标和类别位置映射，这次实测只限官网该控件；包安装和其他比例尺未测试。ISC分发须保留版权与许可，价格仍unknown。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
